terrain:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production material atlas for a top-down pixel-art dungeon game, NOT a room illustration or presentation board.
Use the attached approved four-theme concept image ONLY as a material and pixel finish reference. Transform its materials into a precise reusable texture sheet.
Output a square 1024 x 1024 atlas divided into exactly FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows (16 square cells, each 256 x 256). Every cell is completely filled edge-to-edge with its material. Zero gutters, zero labels, zero margins, no visible grid lines beyond the natural material difference. All cells have equal dimensions.
Columns LEFT TO RIGHT: blue-slate underwater temple; dark warm timber wreck; indigo blue mineral coral abyss; muted warm grey-beige milk sanctuary.
Row 1: quiet seamless flat top-down WALKABLE FLOOR texture for each column. Temple plain blue slate tiles, wreck parallel weathered planks, abyss close-set low-contrast dark blue stones, sanctuary desaturated warm grey-beige limestone. Subtle small pixel clusters, NO emblem, NO conspicuous hero cracks. Repeats must match on all edges. Keep floor dark and low contrast enough for colorful enemies and cream attacks.
Row 2: matching flat top-down WALL CAP material, slightly brighter than floor, reusable masonry coping / thick ship timber and iron / indigo mineral rock / ash-beige coping. Completely fill the square with repeating material, no silhouette, no objects.
Row 3: matching VERTICAL WALL FACE texture, straight horizontal stacked blocks / horizontal timber beams / dark blue rock strata / grey-beige stone courses. Fill all cells edge-to-edge, seamless horizontally.
Row 4: matching solid OBSTACLE TOP texture, plain inset stone blocks / slatted crate tops with iron rivets / tightly packed blue rock tops / plain squared limestone pillar tops. Fill square fully, no perspective, no cast shadow outside texture, no background gaps.
All sixteen cells are orthographic MATERIAL SWATCHES, absolutely no perspective or isometric viewpoint. Deliberate fine pixel clusters, clean controlled edges, subtle handmade texture matching approved reference, no blur, no glossy 3D, no bloom. No shells/scallops/emblems/logos/text/UI/characters/weapons. No large water areas. Texture scale and lighting consistent across all themes. High material fidelity without visual noise.
doors:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production spritesheet for the same top-down dungeon game as the reference; retain its fine pixel-art finish, restrained material palettes and top-down camera.
Create one wide 1536 x 1024 transparent PNG with exactly EIGHT columns and FOUR rows of isolated doorway modules. Every cell exactly equal, transparent margins of at least 12 pixels, no overlaps, no labels, no ground patches and no cast shadows reaching a neighboring cell. Each pair of adjacent columns is the SAME DOOR in open and barred states.
Rows TOP TO BOTTOM: blue-grey stone underwater temple; dark brown timber wreck with iron straps; indigo blue mineral coral abyss with tiny coral accents at jambs; warm grey-beige limestone milk sanctuary.
Columns left to right: NORTH open, NORTH barred; EAST open, EAST barred; SOUTH open, SOUTH barred; WEST open, WEST barred.
Every doorway is a minimal reusable straight wall opening, two modest jambs with no huge arch, with a threshold at the exact center of its cell. Open: dark clear passage with visible threshold. Barred: same shape with plain dark iron horizontal/vertical grate blocking the passage, small restrained amber latch. Orientation is important: NORTH has wall face above threshold viewed from inside room below; SOUTH has low wall top below threshold, viewed from inside room above; EAST is a narrow side doorway along the right edge of a room with visible inner-left jamb face; WEST mirrored architecture along left edge. Draw each direction for the fixed camera and fixed overhead lighting, do not merely rotate a frontal arch image.
Keep doors compact and equal scale, narrow trim and short piers, readable door opening; no huge ornament. Four direction pairs in a row must have consistent materials. Transparent background genuinely transparent. No shells, scallops, badges, emblems, logos, text, UI, characters, weapons, floor decorations, blur, perspective room scenes or glow cloud.
objects:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art sprite atlas for a top-down dungeon game. Match the attached approved room reference's fine deliberate pixel clusters, material finish and fixed overhead lighting. This is a reusable sprite sheet, not a room scene.
Create a square image in a precise 4 by 4 grid, sixteen equal square cells. Keep each object wholly inside its cell with wide transparent margins (12% each side), consistent centre and scale. No text, labels, borders, grid lines, gradients behind objects, drop-shadow haze, background colors, shells or emblems. Genuine zero-alpha background outside objects.
Row 1 left to right: a square recessed iron spike plate with all spikes retracted; THE SAME plate warning with small restrained amber slits; THE SAME plate with short clearly raised silver spikes; a seamless square low-contrast teal shallow water-current texture with subtle ripples pointing RIGHT, fill this fourth cell edge-to-edge.
Row 2: seamless square dark green low-contrast short underwater grass texture, fill this cell edge-to-edge; a squat metal-banded wooden explosive barrel with one tiny orange fuse, top-down three-quarter view; THE SAME barrel cracked/damaged; its low collapsed broken wood and metal remnants, same footprint.
Row 3: a small round dull brass mine with a quiet inset teal indicator and simple ring housing; THE SAME mine lit with an orange central fuse; a plain sturdy wood and iron treasure chest CLOSED, no emblem; THE SAME chest OPEN, a restrained warm interior glint, same foot position.
Row 4: a small clear cyan exit crystal on a restrained circular stone base, no big glow cloud; a small warm brass wall lantern; a tiny cluster of low moss and dark stone chips; a small pink-and-blue coral sprig with a dark rock foot.
Keep water and grass cells perfectly square and seamless; everything else isolated on transparent alpha and fully inside its cell. All objects have complete silhouettes, no cropping, no ground squares behind props. Use fine finished pixel art with crisp material detail, not chunky primitive graphics. Moderate saturation, distinct readable danger states without red rings. Preserve combat readability.
